18: # Huawei Cloud Terraform Installer
19: 
20: Cross-platform Terraform CLI installation with **Huawei Cloud mirror** by default
21: (avoids GitHub network issues).
22: 
23: ## Prerequisites
24: 
25: - **Python 3.6+** (required for installation script)
26: - Network access to:
27:   - `releases.hashicorp.com` (Terraform binary)
28:   - `mirrors.huaweicloud.com` (HuaweiCloud Provider)
29: 
30: ## Platform Support
31: 
32: | Platform | Method | Notes |
33: |----------|--------|-------|
34: | **Linux** | Binary | Direct binary download |
35: | **Windows** | Binary | Direct download |
36: 
37: **Why use binary download only?**
38: 
39: - Simpler and more reliable across all platforms
40: - No dependency on package manager availability
41: - Consistent behavior for troubleshooting
42: 
43: **Note:** macOS is not currently supported.
44: 
45: ### Windows Special Notes
46: 
47: **Provider installation method:**
48: 
49: - Use `filesystem_mirror` (local file mirror)
50: - Download zip from Huawei Cloud mirror, extract to local
51: - Configure `terraform.rc` to point to local directory
52: 
53: **Unsupported methods:**
54: 
55: - ❌ `direct` (Registry → GitHub): GitHub timeout
56: - ❌ `network_mirror`: Huawei Cloud mirror directory structure incompatible
57: 
58: ## Quick Start
59: 
60: ### Basic Installation
61: 
62: ```bash
63: # Auto-install (default to Huawei Cloud mirror)
64: python scripts/install_terraform.py
65: 
66: # Install + Initialize
67: python scripts/install_terraform.py --init
68: 
69: # Install + Test
70: python scripts/install_terraform.py --test
71: ```
72: 
73: ### Specify Version
74: 
75: ```bash
76: # Install specific version
77: python scripts/install_terraform.py --version 1.15.4
78: ```
79: 
80: ### Other Operations
81: 
82: ```bash
83: # Check status only
84: python scripts/install_terraform.py --check
85: 
86: # Uninstall
87: python scripts/install_terraform.py --uninstall
88: ```
89: 
90: ## Mirror Strategy
91: 
92: | Resource | Source | Notes |
93: |----------|--------|-------|
94: | Terraform binary | HashiCorp Releases | Official source |
95: | Provider | Huawei Cloud Mirror (default) | Avoid GitHub network issues |
96: 
97: **Huawei Cloud Mirror:** `https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/terraform/`
